verdict.rationale: Better Stack documents a hosted, branded status page on your own subdomain, set up with a single CNAME record. It also documents customer email subscriptions to the whole page or to selected components. The status-page product page lists monitoring sources (web, API, ping, DNS, Datadog, Grafana and others), which implies the page is fed by monitoring, but no item explicitly says incident state automatically updates the page or triggers subscriber notifications. missing for 10: explicit documentation that incident state drives status page updates and subscriber notifications, notification channels beyond email, independent or hands-on corroboration

support.subject: As an engineering leader, I can publish a hosted public status page — custom domain, subscriber notifications — driven from incident state

citations.quote: Get a beautiful branded status page on your own sub-domain in just a few clicks. Configure a single CNAME record and you’re all set!
Let your customers subscribe to e-mail updates removing the need to reach out to you individually.
Let your customers subscribe to the entire status page or just selected components.
Plug in the services you already use including Datadog, New Relic, Grafana, Prometheus, Zabbix, Azure, AWS & Google Cloud.
